subject: Usage approval request — Quantuma customer feature & logo
message_1_subject: Usage approval request — Quantuma customer feature & logo
message_1_body:
Hi Elena,

Quick one — thank you again for the time last week. We finished a short draft of the customer feature (two pages, highlights performance and integration notes) that we'd love to publish on our site and amplify in next quarter's paid social. We also want to include a small Quantuma logo + one short sentence quote attributed to Samir.

Attached: redwood-quantuma-draft-v1.md (internal draft).

Can you confirm:
- That Quantuma is okay with the use of the full-color logo at the size shown?
- Whether the proposed quote is acceptable (we highlighted the sentence in the draft)?
- Any brand assets or style guidance we should use?

If you’re comfortable, we can send a DocuSign quick approval for a single-use marketing permission; otherwise we can accept an email confirmation.

CCing Monica (CS) and Aditya (solutions) so they have the final draft context. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
message_2_subject: Re: Usage approval request — Quantuma customer feature & logo
message_2_body:
Hi Vivek —

Thanks for sending this over. Happy to support a short customer feature; Quantuma is proud of the work with Redwood. A few notes up front:

1) Please use the attached brand kit (Quantuma_Brand_Guidelines_v3.pdf) for logo spacing and color usage.
2) The logo files are in the attached ZIP (Quantuma_Logo_PNG.zip). Use the PNG on white background for web.
3) The draft quote is largely fine but we need to remove the sentence that references exact throughput numbers (we prefer high-level phrasing). If you could remove the numeric reference, Samir and I can sign off more quickly.

On legal: we can provide a brief email approval for single-use marketing (website + social) once you make that small edit. If you plan to use the case study in paid ads or syndication partners, please flag that — we may need an expanded approval form.

For traceability, I’m attaching the brand kit now and copying Samir.

Best,

—
Elena Petrova
Head of Marketing | Quantuma Analytics
elena@quantuma.com

message_3_subject: Re: Usage approval request — Quantuma customer feature & logo
message_3_body:
Vivek —

Thanks for looping me in. I reviewed Elena's note and the internal draft. Two quick legal requests before we send for final sign-off:

1) Remove or rephrase the explicit throughput number as Elena requested. Replace with a qualitative statement (e.g., 'significant improvement in inference latency').
2) Add a single-sentence permission clause at the end of the case study copy that reads: 'Quantuma grants Redwood Inference permission to publish this customer feature and use Quantuma trademarks in connection with Redwood marketing materials (website and social) for a one-year period from the date of signature.'

If Elena confirms the one-year scope and approves the edited quote, an email from her inbox is sufficient for our records; DocuSign is optional but preferred when marketing will run paid placements.

I attached a redline snippet (we didn't include full file to avoid versioning) — once you make the swap, please send back the updated copy and I'll quick-review.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

message_4_subject: Final — updated case study + request for sign-off
message_4_body:
Hi Elena —

Thanks again. Per your note and Laura's redline, we've removed the numeric throughput sentence and replaced it with: 'resulted in a significant reduction in inference latency and operating overhead.' We also added the short permission clause at the end of the copy as Laura suggested. Draft is here: https://redwood-internal.s3/drive/quantuma-draft-case-study-v2.md (public to your link if easier — let us know).

For convenience I attached the same PNG and a zipped logo in case you need a different size. If the edits look good, would you please reply to this email with a sentence such as: 'Quantuma approves the case study content and grants Redwood permission to use the Quantuma logo on the Redwood website and social channels for one year' — that will suffice for our records. If you prefer DocuSign, I can send now.

Attachments: Quantuma_Brand_Guidelines_v3.pdf (from you), Quantuma_Logo_PNG.zip (from you), redwood-quantuma-draft-v2.pdf (our updated copy export).

Appreciate the help — cc'ing Samir and Laura.

Best,
Vivek
